dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Come on, just spit it out. I can tell you're itching to say something.

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Ahahaha! Kinich, you big dummy, you fell for it, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Nooo, what's wrong, feeling lonely without the Almighty Dragonlord to talk to?

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: If a bedtime story's what you're after, just say so! I'll tell you one so bone-chilling you won't be able to sleep for three nights straight!

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Huh? What do you mean "go ahead"? You pretending to be a tough guy, now?

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Maybe, maybe not. But one thing's for sure — if I don't sleep, neither do you.
